# EcoBridgers

> EcoBridgers is a SaaS, IoT and embedded systems development company based in Surat, Gujarat, India. We build SaaS products, IoT hardware and firmware, web platforms and mobile apps for SMEs, factories and research labs.

Contact: ecobridgers.tech@gmail.com · +91 78629 49437 · Mon–Sat, 10am–7pm IST

## Services
- [SaaS Product Development](https://ecobridgers.com/services/saas): multi-tenant SaaS products for Indian SMEs
- [IoT & Embedded Systems](https://ecobridgers.com/services/iot): ESP32/STM32 firmware, sensors, MQTT, real-time dashboards
- [Mobile App Development](https://ecobridgers.com/services/app): Android and iOS apps
- [Web & Cloud Platforms](https://ecobridgers.com/services/web): Next.js, React, Node.js, AWS, Supabase

## Products
- [Playco](https://ecobridgers.com/work/playco): free social party game app (Imposter hidden-role word game, 3–10 players, offline Pass & Play or online rooms). Download on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ecobridgers.playco
- [TextileBridge](https://ecobridgers.com/work/textilebridge): textile manufacturing and yarn inventory management
- [CafeBridge](https://ecobridgers.com/work/cafebridge): cafe POS and WhatsApp order billing
- [TurfBridge](https://ecobridgers.com/work/turfbridge): sports turf and box cricket booking
- [BIoTSense](https://ecobridgers.com/work/biotsense): industrial machine vibration and temperature telemetry
- [Underground Rover](https://ecobridgers.com/work/underground-rover): R&D rover for hazardous tunnel surveillance
